description: This class defines the orchestration flow for obtaining shipping rate quotes, coordinating with registered shipping providers, handling request metadata, and logging.

classes.name: RateQuoteFlow
classes.description: Orchestrates the process of obtaining shipping rate quotes from multiple providers, managing request IDs and timestamps, and logging the flow.

methods.name: RateQuoteFlow
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the flow with a registry and a clock, defaulting to system UTC clock if not provided.

methods.name: getRateQuotes
methods.description: Executes the rate quote process for a given request, logs the start and end, and returns the quotes.
